capabilities.name: simple prompt
capabilities.requirement: Acceptance precedes provider effects; terminal settlement yields one result and lane.lastResult.

capabilities.name: tool prompt
capabilities.requirement: Tool effect_pending commits before execution; tool result and final run settle once.

capabilities.name: parallel tools
capabilities.requirement: Parallel effects may complete out of order while durable results commit in source order.

capabilities.name: safe replay
capabilities.requirement: Restore re-executes effect_pending only when persisted and current declarations both say safe.

capabilities.name: never replay
capabilities.requirement: Restore settles a never-replay tool under its reserved result ID without re-execution.

capabilities.name: steer
capabilities.requirement: An active operation owns accepted steer until one placement transaction consumes it.

capabilities.name: follow-up
capabilities.requirement: Follow-up stays operation-owned and executes after current work according to queue mode.

capabilities.name: next run
capabilities.requirement: Lane pendingNextRun survives cleanup and one later operation captures it once.

capabilities.name: abort
capabilities.requirement: Cancellation commits before signal pull; late effects cannot create a second terminal settlement.

capabilities.name: compaction
capabilities.requirement: Manual threshold and overflow compaction preserve structural preparation and result state.

capabilities.name: retry
capabilities.requirement: Captured retry policy options and attempt progression survive restore with specified effective options.

capabilities.name: suspension
capabilities.requirement: Deferred missing-identity and crash suspension report the current operation and resume safely.

capabilities.name: restore
capabilities.requirement: Bounded current-register reads reconstruct open state without folding full history.

capabilities.name: corruption
capabilities.requirement: Invalid current-register and reference combinations fail without silent repair.

capabilities.name: lane isolation
capabilities.requirement: Operations configuration and queues do not cross named lanes.

capabilities.name: close
capabilities.requirement: Close writes nothing rejects new work drains admitted commits and leaves open work resumable.

capabilities.name: manual drive
capabilities.requirement: Manual and automatic drive yield identical durable state while one action advances at a time.

capabilities.name: hooks events and watch
capabilities.requirement: Typed hooks obey settlement barriers and snapshot-first buffered event ordering.

capabilities.name: usage
capabilities.requirement: Each settled attempt has one UsageRow and totals equal the non-duplicated ledger sum.

capabilities.name: deferred provider
capabilities.requirement: One poll per resume preserves handle lineage and cancel/restart outcomes.

capabilities.name: parallel tools

capabilities.name: safe replay
capabilities.requirement: Restore re-executes effect_pending only when persisted and current declarations both say safe.
capabilities.evidence: Public JSONL process loss at effect_pending after awaited memo writes: four persisted/current safe-never combinations; safe-safe preserves invocation/turn/operation identity, memo deletion and reserved result ID; settled third-process drive repeats neither fixture invocation nor provider call. Other crash boundaries unproved.

capabilities.name: never replay
capabilities.requirement: Restore settles a never-replay tool under its reserved result ID without re-execution.
capabilities.evidence: Public JSONL process loss: persisted-never or current-never prevents fixture replay, publishes one interrupted tool result at the reserved ID, and remains settled after a third-process drive. Other effects and crash points unproved.

capabilities.name: steer
capabilities.requirement: An active operation owns accepted steer until one placement transaction consumes it.
capabilities.evidence: queue admission, lane identity and cancellation; active-run steer crash races not proved

capabilities.name: follow-up
capabilities.requirement: Follow-up stays operation-owned and executes after current work according to queue mode.
capabilities.evidence: queue admission, lane identity and cancellation; finish-boundary follow-up crash races not proved

capabilities.name: next run
capabilities.requirement: Lane pendingNextRun survives cleanup and one later operation captures it once.
capabilities.evidence: nextRun consumed once by an accepted successor; process-loss retention not proved

capabilities.name: abort
capabilities.requirement: Cancellation commits before signal pull; late effects cannot create a second terminal settlement.
capabilities.evidence: requestAbort uses exact operation identity; late invocation write is rejected; abort drains steer/follow-up while preserving nextRun; terminal settlement invokes no new provider effect.

capabilities.name: compaction
capabilities.requirement: Manual threshold and overflow compaction preserve structural preparation and result state.
capabilities.evidence: Public manual compaction after one deterministic turn writes one compaction entry and immutable result, clears the operation, and publishes ordered compaction events; unsummarized navigation publishes one result and moves to the exact target. Threshold, overflow, summarized navigation, decline and crash boundaries remain unproved.

capabilities.name: retry
capabilities.requirement: Captured retry policy options and attempt progression survive restore with specified effective options.
capabilities.evidence: A transient faux provider error durably enters long retry waiting; public close/reopen preserves exact operation identity/notBefore and captured policy despite changed process defaults. A separate zero-delay retry advances exactly once and settles. Exhaustion, timer-abort and structural retry variants remain unproved.

capabilities.name: suspension
capabilities.requirement: Deferred missing-identity and crash suspension report the current operation and resume safely.
capabilities.evidence: Deferred prompt and repeated suspension preserve exact operation/handle lineage across public repository reopen; unavailable selected model settles in band without provider execution. Other suspension causes and cancellation races remain unproved.

capabilities.name: restore
capabilities.requirement: Bounded current-register reads reconstruct open state without folding full history.
capabilities.evidence: Accepted-undriven operation reopens through public repository inventory and settles with one provider call; repeated drive returns the immutable result without replay. Bounded internal read counts and every durable leaf remain unproved without public raw Storage instrumentation.

capabilities.name: corruption
capabilities.requirement: Invalid current-register and reference combinations fail without silent repair.
capabilities.evidence: Public Session writes an incomplete lane register set referencing a missing operation; real constructor rejects while the register remains unchanged and the branch still exists. Other corruption variants unproved.

capabilities.name: lane isolation
capabilities.requirement: Operations configuration and queues do not cross named lanes.
capabilities.evidence: no implicit lane; atomic same-name acquire and configuration isolation

capabilities.name: close
capabilities.requirement: Close writes nothing rejects new work drains admitted commits and leaves open work resumable.
capabilities.evidence: close invokes no provider; accepted-undriven operation restored from public repository

capabilities.name: manual drive
capabilities.requirement: Manual and automatic drive yield identical durable state while one action advances at a time.
capabilities.evidence: Public prompt versus accept-drive for one deterministic turn produces equal role/content transcript, completed result kind/status, empty queues and one provider call. Full boundary-by-boundary state equality remains unproved.

capabilities.name: hooks events and watch
capabilities.requirement: Typed hooks obey settlement barriers and snapshot-first buffered event ordering.
capabilities.evidence: before_run registration order, snapshot/buffer delivery and blocked terminal hook are proved; public reduceLaneSnapshot folds one ordinary run event stream to an equal resnapshot. Navigation rebase and other interleavings remain unproved; watchSession stub remains unsupported.

capabilities.name: usage
capabilities.requirement: Each settled attempt has one UsageRow and totals equal the non-duplicated ledger sum.
capabilities.evidence: explicit adjustments yield stable lane/session usage totals; retry-cost provenance remains Piclaw-owned

capabilities.name: deferred provider
capabilities.requirement: One poll per resume preserves handle lineage and cancel/restart outcomes.
capabilities.evidence: Faux deferred submission performs zero polls initially, exactly one poll per public resume, survives two public repository reopens, preserves operation/handle lineage, and completes without resubmission; abort cancels the exact deferred handle and settles once. Unknown-poll process loss remains unproved.

capabilities.name: effect admission
capabilities.requirement: Every selected Gate.admit() site proves abort-first starts nothing and admission-first receives the operation signal.
capabilities.evidence: Public abort-first prevents provider admission; admission-first starts one tool and the exact operation requestAbort flips its trailing Context abortSignal before settlement. Hook/provider/timer site coverage remains unproved because Gate is not public.

capabilities.name: effect-start crash
capabilities.requirement: Crash after admission but before settlement is treated as unknown and follows provider/tool/structural replay policy.
capabilities.evidence: Public JSONL process loss after awaited memo writes and a durable tool-output checkpoint at effect_pending proves safe-safe replay and never containment under stable invocation/result identity, followed by no settled replay. Provider and structural unknown-effect variants remain unproved.

capabilities.name: Drive/host ownership
capabilities.requirement: One lane-owned Drive serves observers; process replacement reattaches without duplicate writable authority.
capabilities.evidence: Two public same-operation drive observers return one equal result with one provider call; public close/reopen reattaches open operations. Cross-process host replacement and duplicate writable authority remain outside the in-process SessionRepo boundary.

capabilities.name: storage migration
capabilities.requirement: A selected storage version migrates an open operation totally and resumes after a crash at every boundary.
capabilities.evidence: Published 0.85.1 exposes neither built-in Memory/JSONL raw Storage constructors nor public fixture factories, so downstream open-operation migration fault injection is not supportable without private access.

capabilities.name: backend/fork parity
capabilities.requirement: Memory, JSONL and selected SQLite plus host ownership and streaming-fork boundaries produce specified outcomes.
capabilities.evidence: Supported public SessionRepo suites pass 17 Memory and 15 JSONL cases including fork behavior and ownership. Raw Storage, SQLite, streaming-fork parity and host-process ownership are not admitted.

harnessCases.evidence: send/requestId persists one input and generation task before provider execution; terminal input/entry outcome is retained.
tool tasks persist the finalized call and replay checkpoint before invocation, then append one result and join through post_tools.
parallel tool tasks settle independently and post_tools joins their terminal outcomes in source-call order.
reopened safe tools replay only when persisted and current declarations both remain safe.
reopened unsafe tools synthesize an interrupted result and do not invoke the external tool again.
busy input with whenBusy=steer is durably queued and placed at a post-tools/final boundary.
busy follow-up input is durably queued and placed at an eligible final boundary.
The exported SendInput supports steer/followUp/reject only; no next-run queue mode is implemented.
task abort marks persist before invocation cancellation; scheduler joins run execution before the abort closure settles.
manual/threshold/overflow collapse uses durable tasks, captured prefixes, retries and atomic summary/head publication.
generation and collapse retries persist attempt policy, retry timestamp and attempt progression.
deferred provider handles and poll times are durable; reopen resumes polling and abort performs best-effort cancellation.
Memory/JSONL reopen restores pending/running tasks, documents, inputs and exact referenced entries without task-history folding.
atomicity, hardening and JSONL recovery tests reject malformed or incomplete committed state rather than repairing silently.
conversation scope checks, ownership subtrees, namespace tokens and one owning Session per Storage enforce in-process isolation.
suspend joins local invocations and closes storage without terminalizing durable tasks; reopen resumes them.
The published implementation auto-dispatches after resume(); it does not expose the explicit gated/manual drive contract required by HC-017.
typed hooks, snapshot-first watches, bounded buffering and commit-granular envelopes are implemented and tested.
provider/tool usage is persisted in strict-JSON entries and outcomes, but no independent UsageRow ledger/totals parity is proved.
deferred handles survive reopen with explicit polling and cancellation behavior.
Pico3 uses committed in-flight checkpoints and invocation leases but has no Gate.admit primitive or site-completeness evidence.
in-flight checkpoints distinguish unknown provider/tool/process outcomes and apply kind-specific retry, adoption or interruption policy.
one scheduler invocation claim owns each task in process; duplicate writable cross-process authority is outside the implementation.
No storage-version migration surface, SQLite backend or open-operation migration fault suite is exported.
Memory and JSONL history/reopen tests pass; SQLite, migration and cross-process host ownership are absent.
